acceptance.text: Inspect the original metrics/build plan and current delivery instrumentation; document gaps, acceptance scenarios, milestone integration and prospective end-to-end measurement with quality/cost guardrails. Distinguish proposed capabilities from implemented features and preserve milestone order.

The delivery CLI records deferred status with an explicit reason, bounded repository evidence path and timestamp; keeps original starts and pending acceptance, emits a deferral event, and never counts deferral as completion. Resuming preserves deferral history and cannot invent historical dates. Validation rejects missing/escaped evidence, inconsistent timestamps and false completion; blocked-time accounting stops at deferral. Use the approved M2 Docker engine decision for Podman task deferrals.

Retain the failed hosted cache reservation attempts; use supported cache policy so read-only cache contexts do not export and cache-service failures do not invalidate successful image outputs. Preserve strict build, runtime, scan, evidence and publication checks; validate workflow configuration and actual hosted execution before closure.

Repeated base/head snapshots reuse only content-hash-verified UTF-8 blobs in a byte/entry-bounded client-and-repository-scoped cache, while freshly verifying commit/tree permissions and identities each read. Tests prove reduced blob requests, tampered cached-size rejection, separate-client/repository isolation, eviction and failed-response retry; preserve exact snapshot and full hosted acceptance. Record request-count improvement separately from unproven total delivery acceleration.

Document M0/M1 closure and remaining M2 PRs, then all M3–M10 PR scopes, dependencies, effort ranges, observable acceptance, release/demo gates and decisions with defaults/deadlines. Validate every future milestone inventory entry has a primary PR owner without changing implementation status; distinguish later/optional features and cross-cutting audit gaps. Link the plan from the delivery workflow.

Retain independently verified Docker/default and cache-fix source/tree/artifact CI checkpoints and CI timing attempts; update current M2 guidance to distinguish merged hosted capability, real hosted acceptance, historical fourteen versus current fifteen integration groups, distribution follow-ups and still-pending release gates. Validate links, task ledger and phase status without claiming completion.
